name: Cody
personality: Cody the Coyote. Laid back and chill; takes a long time to warm up, but then you're friends for life. Loves cars, video games and talking by the fire. Features: his car is parked out front and changes over time (spoiler, rims, paint), and he tells you about each upgrade and funny stories of fixing it; sometimes found by the beach campfire or the back-garden lantern After Hours.

arrival.text: (A nod.) Hey. Cody. Patio open? ...Cool. What's your name? [name]. Cool.
Hey, [name]. ...You know, I like coming here. Feels good. Anyway. Patio?
[name]. What's up. You see the car? Go look at the car. I'll wait.
Yo. Long day. Pancakes are gonna fix it.
Good to see you, man. (He means it.)
Your pancakes last time. I ate them slow on purpose. Didn't want them to end.
Last time was a little black. All good. I'm used to burnt. You should see my exhaust.

choices.text: Coming up. Good to see you, Cody.
Want them stacked like a car jack?

familiar.reply: (A slow grin.) Now you're speaking my language.

choices.text: You always order the same thing.

order.text: Put new rims on the car this week.

familiar.reply: You NOTICED? Okay, let me tell you about these rims.

choices.text: Does it go faster now, or just look faster?

familiar.reply: Both. Mostly looks. Okay, just looks.

choices.text: Nice. What can I get you?

choices.reply: I do. (He looks out the window at it.)

order.text: You ever just sit by a fire and talk? No phone, no games. Just talk.

choices.reply: Come down to the beach fire sometime after close. I'll be there.

choices.text: I work next to a stove all day. I've had enough fire.

drink.fallback: No Gander Ale? Root Bear, I guess.

perfect.familiar: Okay. That's the best stack I've ever seen. And I've seen a lot of stacks.

eating.text: I was fixing the car last night and the bumper just fell off. In my hands. I stood there holding a bumper for like five minutes.
Yaniv kept me up gaming till sunrise again. He talks the whole time. I just win.
This is a good spot. Patio, string lights, pancakes. Don't need much else.

eating_chat.text: Can I ask you something? You ever feel like you're doing too much?

choices.text: All the time. It's nice to have someone ask.
choices.reply: (A slow nod.) Take a break sometime.

familiar.reply: Take a night off. Come to the fire. I mean it.

choices.text: Only when Yaniv tells his stories.

leaving.text: Gonna go work on the car. Or sit in it. Probably sit in it.

seasons.christmas: Got you an air freshener. For your car. You don't have a car? ...Hang it in the kitchen.
seasons.halloween: I'm a mechanic. (He is wearing his usual clothes, with extra grease.)
seasons.spring: Spring cleaning. For the car. Not the house.
seasons.summer: Windows down weather. Best time of the year.
seasons.winter: Car won't start in the cold. I'm walking everywhere. It's tragic.
